data.name: Hussein
data.gender_notes: Hussein is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Diminutive of Ḥasan, from the root ح-س-ن (ḥ-s-n), 'good, beautiful'. Its root is ح-س-ن (ḥ-s-n). Borne by Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, grandson of the Prophet ﷺ. Hussein is a Arabic name meaning “Little handsome; diminutive of Hasan”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hussein expresses “Little handsome; diminutive of Hasan”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Diminutive of Ḥasan, from the root ح-س-ن (ḥ-s-n), 'good, beautiful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hussein total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
